idea-plugin.name: SDD Flutter Architecture Generator
idea-plugin.description:
Official plugin for Android Studio and IntelliJ IDEA created by Ing. Juan Pablo Gosalvez (com.nyk). Automates the generation of Flutter projects and feature modules following the SDD Mobile (Spec-Driven Development Mobile) architecture with pure BLoC state management and strict layer separation (data, logic, presentation).

Features / Funcionalidades:

  • New SDD Flutter Feature: Generates complete modular feature structure (data layer with models, repository contracts/implementations, and services; logic layer with BLoC, event, and state; presentation layer with Material 3 screen and widgets).
  • New SDD BLoC (logic): Quickly generates connected BLoC files (bloc, event, state) using Dart part/part of directives.
  • Bootstrap SDD Project Core: Sets up production base infrastructure for Flutter apps (lib/app/, lib/core/, l10n.yaml, app_es.arb, Material 3 light/dark themes, and routes).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Version 1.0.0

  • Initial Release: Official launch of SDD Flutter Architecture Generator.
  • Added New SDD Flutter Feature action to generate clean modular feature folders (data, logic, presentation).
  • Added New SDD BLoC action for quick BLoC state management boilerplate generation.
  • Added Bootstrap SDD Project Core action to initialize app themes, localization (l10n), routes, and extension utilities.
  • Full compatibility with Android Studio 2024.1+ / 2025.x and IntelliJ IDEA.

action.description: Genera la estructura modular data, logic y presentation para un nuevo feature
Genera únicamente los 3 archivos BLoC (bloc, event, state) con la estructura SDD Mobile
Genera la infraestructura base del proyecto (app, core, l10n, theme, root)
